aboutHtml:
We're a family-owned shop in Invercargill that's been supporting locals with outdoor power equipment since 1985. Shirley and Gillon Muirhead know what works in Southland conditions, and we stock only brands we believe will outlast and outperform the rest: STIHL, Masport, Honda, Rover, and more.

We service what we sell. Our staff are qualified small engine service technicians, STIHL factory qualified, and we've got the fully equipped workshop and spare parts to handle repairs. Whether it's your chainsaw, mower, trimmer, line trimmer, blower or any other outdoor power equipment, we'll get it running properly again.

Come in and talk to us. We'll match you with the right tool for your job and budget, get it started and ready to go, and be here to back it up with advice and servicing.
